g.text: Open Imaging Data Model: three layers joined by identifiers
Each layer depends on the one below it. Codes minted in the semantic foundation are what the data structures carry and the applications exchange.
Terminologies underneath: RadLex, SNOMED CT, FMA, UMLS, MeSH, LOINC and the RSNA Radiology Playbook. Looked up through med-ontology-lookup.
finding models graduate to CDEs; CDE definitions seed finding models
dashed outline: documented or planned only
